subject: Mutual Commitment Canvas — first pass + slides & proposed workshop
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@edata.ai>, Samuel Cho <sam.cho@pineview.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Commitment Canvas — first pass + slides & proposed workshop

Hi Elena / Samuel,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, attached is a lightweight first-pass "Mutual Commitment Canvas" that maps the evaluation milestones, decision criteria, and required Redwood deliverables for the PineView proof-of-concept. I also included a short slide deck that we can run through in a 45-minute workshop.

What you'll find:
- One-page MAP canvas (roles, success metrics, timeline anchors)
- 60/30/14 day milestone breakdown with acceptance criteria per milestone
- Risk/gating checklist (security, data access, model fidelity)
- Owner recommendations from our side (SE, CS, infra contact)

Asks:
1) Can you confirm the two primary stakeholders on your side who should be owners of the success criteria?
2) Are the acceptance criteria for the POC (latency < 200ms P95, 95% coverage on target prompts) acceptable or should we tighten?
3) Would next Wed (11/18) 10:00–10:45 PT work for a joint workshop to finalize the MAP?

Links & attachments: I uploaded the editable canvas and slides to Drive so we can co-edit: https://drive.google.com/open?id=map-canvas-v0.1 (MAP_canvas_v0.1.gdoc), https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/initial-map-deck (Initial_MAP_deck_v0.1.gslides). I also attached a short proposal summary PDF.

If you're comfortable, we can lock the MAP after the workshop and push a signed timeline into HubSpot (I can create the deal timeline).

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_canvas_v0.1.gdoc (drive link), Initial_MAP_deck_v0.1.gslides (drive link), proposal_summary.pdf
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@edata.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Samuel Cho <sam.cho@pineview.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Commitment Canvas — first pass + slides & proposed workshop

Thanks Logan — this looks like a great starting point. Quick thoughts inline: 

- Stakeholders: I'll own product requirements and Samuel will own infra/ops on our side. I'll also loop in our security lead once the MAP is locked.
- Acceptance criteria: latency target looks reasonable; can we add an additional qualitative prompt-set pass rate (we usually require 4/5 human raters agreement on 50 sample prompts) as a fidelity gate?
- Workshop: 11/18 10:00 PT works for me, Samuel confirmed tentatively.

Also, please add a line in the MAP about data retention and log access — we need clarity on how long interaction logs persist and what will be available for our audit team.

Elena Ruiz
Head of Product | EData.ai
elena@edata.ai

Looping in a few technical clarifications so we can set realistic engineering milestones: 

- For the latency P95 target at expected production load, we'll need access to a representative prompt sample and expected QPS. If PineView can share the sample set before 11/16, we'll run a short perf run and validate kernels/quantization profile.
- Regarding logs/retention: default hosted logs are 30 days; for the POC we can enable extended retention to 90 days (requires legal/contract note). I'll draft language for the MAP.
- Security checkpoint: recommend a brief SOC2 evidence checklist before the pilot start date; Marissa, can you prepare the stub?

Attached: proposal_summary.pdf (one-page summary that ties the MAP milestones to deliverables).

— Dev

Subject: Re: Mutual Commitment Canvas — first pass + slides & proposed workshop

Elena / Samuel — thanks for the quick responses and the confirmations. Summary of what's agreed so far and next steps before the workshop: 

1) Owners confirmed: Elena (product), Samuel (infra). Redwood: Logan (SE lead), Marissa (CS owner), Dev (solutions architect).
2) Acceptance criteria updated: latency P95 < 200ms; prompt-set fidelity gate added (4/5 rater agreement on 50-sample set).
3) Security & retention: Redwood to insert MAP language for 90-day retention for POC and a SOC2 evidence checklist. Marissa to share the checklist by EOD 11/13.
4) Deliverables before workshop (11/18): PineView to share representative prompt sample and QPS estimate by 11/16; Redwood to run a perf pass and post results in the shared Drive.
5) Workshop confirmed: 11/18 10:00–10:45 PT — invite to follow.

I'll lock the Drive files to comment-only for external participants, then create a HubSpot milestone timeline and link it in the MAP. Samuel — if you'd like a separate infra prep slot to discuss network/VPC options, we can add a short follow-up meeting after the workshop.

Thanks all — looking forward to finalizing this.

Regards,
Logan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
